title: Dynaconf本地配置工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：在真实文件加载前整体验证文本路径协议并拒绝非法参数；修复复用条件Validator跨环境与并发实例的继承状态泄漏；让真实批量更新先取得顶层输入快照且不污染调用者映射；让无扩展名配置显式选择已启用的真实JSONTOMLYAML加载器；把JSONliteral或本地值解析器限制到当前实例的真实加载路径；为真实配置CLI提供可重复大小写无关glob筛选且保持存储不变。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Fix Settings.load_file input normalization: allow None/str/text os.PathLike and finite list/tuple of those, normalize via os.fspath and validate the complete sequence before any loading. Reject modules/dicts/numbers/bytes/bad __fspath__ return values with TypeError regardless of silent. Preserve string module names, comma-list/glob and PathLike real-file behavior plus optional None/empty/no-match semantics. Do not stringify arbitrary objects into pretend paths, mutate input sequences or modify the general ensure_a_list contract across unrelated APIs.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_dynaconf_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-dynaconf-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.
